market_question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?
reasoning: With Bitcoin around $85k, a dip to $75k is a ~12% decline. Using 60% annualised volatility, the probability of touching that level in a month is about 45%, well below the market-implied 57.5%. The No contract is therefore undervalued.
evidence_points: BTC/USDT spot price near $85k in late April 2025
Monthly IV typically 40–60%, giving a 1‑sigma range of ~$71k–$100k
Touch probability estimate of 45% from a simple driftless barrier model
Market overestimates the likelihood of such a wick, possibly due to recency bias or fear
